scope: Initial HEAD-only comparison plus subsequent anonymous connection probes; no account credentials; standard certificate validation enabled
conclusion: Initial TLS 1.2 successes did not reproduce consistently. Connection resets remain intermittent; ALPN is not established as the root cause or a stable fix. No live account login was attempted.

later_observations.anonymous_captcha_init: HTTP 200 with a captcha_token field and no url field was observed in an isolated reqwest native-TLS probe; the token was not printed or saved.
later_observations.same_binary_repeat: Both default and preconfigured native-TLS requests later failed with Connect/WinError 10054 without configuration changes.
later_observations.runtime_workaround_status: The application uses the compatible native-TLS configuration and at most four connection-only attempts. This does not establish successful or reliable live login.
